Third-party component: Xpdf pdftotext
=====================================

Component   : pdftotext (command line PDF to text converter)
Version     : 4.01.01
Copyright   : Copyright 1996-2019 Glyph & Cog, LLC
Upstream    : Xpdf, https://www.xpdfreader.com/
License     : GNU General Public License, version 2 (the same license as this project)
Bundled as  : src/IcedAstroGrep.App/Resources/pdftotext.exe
SHA-256     : 1537FAC2FEFA3AC26164401D566D8FC55EA7CDA1F9BF502AE4303090F70740B1
Size        : 1,074,176 bytes

How it is used
--------------
IcedAstroGrep embeds the unmodified pdftotext executable as a resource and extracts it to a
temporary folder at runtime to extract the text of PDF documents. The binary itself is not
modified in any way; only its SHA-256 is recorded above so a shipped copy can be verified.


Licensing
---------
Glyph & Cog distributes Xpdf under two licenses: the GNU General Public License, and a commercial
license. This project uses it under the GPL, which is compatible with its own GPL-2.0-or-later
licensing.

"Glyph & Cog distributes Xpdf under two different licenses: An open source license - the GNU
General Public License (GPL) - A commercial license"
    -- https://www.glyphandcog.com/opensource.html

For use outside the GPL, a commercial license must be obtained from Glyph & Cog:
    https://www.glyphandcog.com/sourcelic.html


Redistribution requirement - read before publishing a release
-------------------------------------------------------------
Glyph & Cog states the condition attached to redistributing the standalone executables:

"If you want to use the stand-alone executables (pdftotext for example) with your application,
you're free to do so. (To comply with the GPL, you'll need to distribute the Xpdf documentation
along with the pdftotext executable - see the Xpdf README file for details.)"
    -- https://www.glyphandcog.com/opensource.html

The Xpdf README puts the same requirement in concrete terms:

"I don't mind if you redistribute Xpdf in source and/or binary form, as long as you include all of
the documentation: README, man pages (or help files), and COPYING."
    -- Xpdf README, Distribution section

So a release of this application must ship, together with the executable:

  1. this notice,
  2. the tool's help text  -> pdftotext-4.01.01-help.txt (captured from the bundled binary itself),
  3. the licence text      -> the GPL-2 in this repository's LICENSE file, which is the same
                              document Xpdf ships as COPYING.

Both files in this folder are copied next to the application by the App project, so a publish
output or release zip already contains them. See "Third-party components" in NOTICE.


Corresponding source
--------------------
Xpdf source code, including the pdftotext sources for this version, is published by Glyph & Cog at
https://www.xpdfreader.com/download.html
